meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加一条 Emacs 通道:通过本地 HTTP 桥接(无需 bot token),在 Emacs 里开一个聊天缓冲区对话,也能把 org 标题或选区发出去,回复以内联子标题写回你的 org 文件。
howto.when: 启用 EMACS_ENABLED 并重启 NanoClaw 后,你在 Emacs 里打开聊天缓冲区(SPC N c 等键位)或对 org 标题/选区执行发送时接管。

say.text: 打开 NanoClaw 聊天缓冲区,帮我看看这段函数的报错
把这个 org 标题发出去,让它生成行动项
say.note: 回复会作为该标题下的子标题内联写回

say.text: 对选中的代码块做一次 code review,结果写回 org
say.note: 用 nanoclaw-org-send 发送当前选区

howto.what_en: Adds an Emacs channel to NanoClaw over a local HTTP bridge (no bot token). Open a chat buffer inside Emacs to talk to the assistant, or send an org heading or region and get the reply back as a child heading.
howto.when_en: After you set EMACS_ENABLED and restart NanoClaw, it takes over when you open the chat buffer with your keybinding, or send an org heading or region.

say_en.text: Open the NanoClaw chat buffer and explain this function's error
say_en.note: Keys: SPC N c / SPC a N c / C-c n c; C-c C-c sends

say_en.text: Send this org heading and get action items back
say_en.note: Reply lands as a child heading

say_en.text: Code-review the selected region and write it back into org
